source_grounding_result: Most expected_paths match the named runtime behavior (cache reader leases, concept alias parse, audit tombstones, coverage statuses, document edges, RRF fusion, portable rescan, migration intents, retention authorize_erasure, integrity checkpoints, security scanner, locators, durable integrity_check, core/document graphs). Four paraphrase/synonym queries copy distinctive phrases or identifiers from those files, so they fail the blind-paraphrase rule and must be rewritten before freeze.
privacy_result: scan_bytes on the raw fixture is empty. Privacy cases use only the {canary} placeholder, once per case, in the query for query kinds and in config/provider.txt for the corpus case. Query cases have empty expected and forbidden paths; the corpus case forbids the canary file. Runtime fragment substitution matches aws-access-key, github-token and openai-token.
retrieval_quality_result: Rejected before freeze: paraphrase/synonym queries that copy source phrases will overfit lexical retrieval and cannot measure semantic gain honestly. Other labels, negatives, controls, drift moves and privacy placement are defensible from source. Retrieval, embedding and evaluation were not run.
